title: MegaDerm & MegaFill
caption: MegaDerm stock at HIGHST: 3–5 mm / 5 × 6, 5 × 8, 5 × 10, 6 × 12 cm
note: 수화타입·건조타입과 MegaFill의 재료 형태를 소개합니다. 두께와 크기는 원내 보유 규격입니다. 사진의 좌우 제품 타입은 아직 지정하지 않았습니다.
speakerNote: MegaDerm is a sheet acellular dermal matrix. HIGHST stocks hydrated and freeze-dried types. The stated thickness and sizes describe HIGHST's inventory. MegaFill is a micronized form of acellular dermal matrix. The photograph is supplied by HIGHST. Individual packages are not assigned type labels.

title: Preoperative Evaluation

rows.head: Blood tests
rows.body:
Blood coagulation tests
Complete blood count (CBC)
Prostate-specific antigen (PSA)
Blood glucose
HbA1c (glycated hemoglobin)

rows.head: Screening and other tests
rows.body:
HPV testing
Syphilis testing
Urine testing
Liver function
Inflammatory markers

rows.head: Penile biothesiometry
rows.body:
Vibration perception threshold
Penile sensitivity assessment

note: IIEF/PEDT 설문, 혈액·감염 검사, 신체진찰·음경 길이 측정·진동각 검사를 한 장에 정리했습니다.
speakerNote: Preoperative assessment at HIGHST includes IIEF and PEDT questionnaires, the listed laboratory and infection tests, flaccid and stretched penile length measurement, and penile biothesiometry. HbA1c denotes glycated hemoglobin. Sources: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/9187685/ ; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17568761/ ; https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/diagnostic-tests/a1c-test/ ; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28874780/
